prompt: Run a needs-based life insurance analysis for Spouse A: salary $110K (Spouse B earns $70K), mortgage $320K, other debts $25K, two kids who need $120K each for college, $60K per year of income replacement for 15 years discounted at a 3% real rate, and $15K of final expenses. Existing resources: $220K of group life on A and $150K of taxable investments earmarked for survivors. How much coverage should A buy?

assertions.text: PV of income replacement is approximately $716K
Mentions the group life coverage and existing investments as offsets
